issues.explanation: The count «۱۲ اصطلاح» for clause 3 of INSO 23681:1403 is not supported by any cited evidence item. The evidence pack provides only five term entries (T23681-3.1.1 through T23681-3.1.5) and one indirect mention of term 3.2.2 (in S23681-042), totalling at most six identifiable terms. No evidence item states the total term count in clause 3. The figure count of 32 abbreviations is correctly supported by F23681-table14.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «۱۲ اصطلاح» with the defensible formulation «اصطلاح‌هایی از جمله ۳.۱.۱ تا ۳.۱.۵» or «چند اصطلاح (تعداد کامل در بستهٔ شواهد این فصل تأیید نشده)» until a T23681 term-count evidence item is added.

issues.explanation: The cross-reference «اصطلاح ۳.۲.۲» asserts that فراپارامتر has a term definition in clause 3.2.2 of INSO 23681:1403. No T23681-3.2.2 evidence item is present in the cited evidence pack; only S23681-042 (clause 6.5.3.1) confirms the use of «فراپارامتر» in body text. A project-level terminology table may record this clause, but that table is not a cited evidence item for this section.
issues.suggested_fix: Either add a T23681-3.2.2 evidence item to the pack, or annotate the reference: «اصطلاح ۳.۲.۲ (بر اساس مرور کامل استاندارد، نه بستهٔ شواهد این فصل)» to avoid presenting an unverified clause number as evidence-backed.

issues.explanation: The qualifier «(توصیفی)» is applied to three table rows corresponding to clauses 6.5.3.1, 6.5.3.6, and 6.5.4.6. All three evidence items — S23681-042, S23681-058, and S23681-065 — are tagged [shall] with no descriptive or reduced-force qualification. Adding «(توصیفی)» implicitly assigns these «باید» expressions a lower obligation level than the evidence supports, which contradicts the section's own framing: the opening paragraph reserves the non-«باید» treatment only for «ضروری است / لازم است / الزامی است», explicitly stating that their printed wording is reproduced as-is. Applying a similar softening qualifier to plain «باید» rows is inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: Delete «(توصیفی)» from these three rows and record them as «باید» without qualification, matching the [shall] tagging of the evidence. Any editorial comment about their contextual nature belongs in a separate footnote clearly labelled as compiler interpretation.
